title: Moore photographs documents in an upstate New York hotel room

tellings.quote: He had to go one time he was told in the middle of this he said go to this hotel room in upstate New York.

plain: Greg Bishop, a writer who has researched UFO deception, says on podcast host Jesse Michels' show that the UFO researcher Bill Moore told of being sent, in the early 1980s, to a hotel room in upstate New York. According to the story, Moore was told to go there partway through his dealings with government contacts, and he photographed documents in that room. It matters because it would show insiders were feeding him secret papers in a carefully controlled way.
